# MeTenk

> MeTenk builds free, privacy-first productivity tools for the web. Our flagship product is a browser extension combining a Pomodoro focus timer, to-do list, and reminders for Chrome, Edge, and Firefox. All data stays local on the user's device — we do not sell or upload user data.

MeTenk (https://metenk.com/) is the official website for the MeTenk productivity extension and related tools by an independent team focused on safety, practicality, minimalism, and efficiency.

## Products

- [MeTenk — Focus, Todo List & Pomodoro Timer](https://metenk.com/): Free browser extension for Chrome, Edge, and Firefox. Pomodoro timer, to-do list, focus reminders, side panel support. Local-first privacy.
- [Clock Max](https://metenk.com/clockmax.html): A precision clock and time-management companion product by MeTenk.
